import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path
import runpy
old = runpy.run_path('old_reader.py')['QUERY']
new = runpy.run_path('new_reader.py')['QUERY']
db = sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
db.executescript(Path('001_initial.sql').read_text())
db.execute('INSERT INTO users (id, name) VALUES (?, ?)', (1, 'Example'))
def check(label, query, should_work):
    try:
        rows = db.execute(query).fetchall()
        assert rows == [(1, 'Example')], rows
        works = True
        detail = repr(rows)
    except sqlite3.OperationalError as exc:
        works = False
        detail = str(exc)
    assert works == should_work, (label, works, should_work)
    print(f'{label}: {\"OK\" if works else \"FAIL\"} — {detail}')
check('Initial schema / old reader', old, True)
check('Initial schema / new reader', new, False)
db.executescript(Path('002_up.sql').read_text())
check('After up / old instances during rollout', old, False)
check('After up / new instances during rollout', new, True)
check('Rollback old binary before down', old, False)
db.executescript(Path('002_down.sql').read_text())
check('After down / old reader', old, True)
check('After down / any remaining new reader', new, False)
print('All compatibility expectations verified; round-trip data preserved.')
PY"
